category.name: Email, messaging and chat
category.description: Send and receive email, SMS and chat messages; manage meetings.

entries.name: AgentMail
entries.auth_hint: Authorization: Bearer <api_key>
entries.free_tier: Free: 3 inboxes, 3,000 emails/month (max 100/day), 3GB storage, no card required
entries.desc_en: Programmatically create inboxes and send/receive email autonomously, purpose-built for AI agents.
entries.notes: Newer, smaller vendor than legacy ESPs; markets itself specifically as agent-native email infra with a built-in MCP server.

rate_limits.summary: Per-organization API limits (unpublished); 429 with Retry-After on excess. Free plan capped at 100 emails/day

entries.name: AWS End User Messaging SMS
entries.auth_hint: AWS Signature Version 4 with IAM credentials (use an AWS SDK or CLI: aws pinpoint-sms-voice-v2 send-text-message)
entries.free_tier: Paid only; US SMS $0.00774/message + $0.00421 carrier fee (10DLC or toll-free)
entries.desc_en: Send SMS, MMS and voice messages and manage sender numbers, opt-outs and registrations via the AWS SMS and Voice v2 API.
entries.notes: New accounts start in a sandbox: $1/month spend limit, up to 10 verified destination numbers. Production access needs an AWS Support case (reviewed, about 24 h). US sending needs a registered 10DLC or toll-free number. SendTextMessage defaults to 1 request/s per region. The AWS MCP Server is generic (calls any AWS API).

auth_scheme.format: AWS SigV4-signed request (Authorization: AWS4-HMAC-SHA256 Credential=...) to sms-voice.<region>.amazonaws.com

rate_limits.summary: SendTextMessage 1 request/s per region by default (raisable); 1 msg/s per recipient; sandbox $1/month spend

entries.name: Bird (formerly MessageBird)
entries.auth_hint: Authorization: Bearer bk_<region>_... workspace API key (dashboard), or OAuth 2.0 user token (auth code + PKCE or device flow)
entries.free_tier: Paid only; prepaid wallet, US long code or toll-free $0.0035/SMS + carrier fees
entries.desc_en: Send SMS, email and WhatsApp messages, verify phone numbers and track delivery via REST API or hosted MCP.
entries.notes: SMS draws on a prepaid wallet (402 if empty). Destination countries are default-deny except your home country; enable more in the dashboard. US long codes need 10DLC registration; the US has no alphanumeric senders. Hosted MCP uses OAuth; a local stdio MCP runs via the bird CLI (bird mcp).

rate_limits.summary: Per-organization regional policies (e.g. sms_send); quota in RateLimit-Policy header; 429 with Retry-After

async_jobs.how: POST /v1/sms/messages returns 202 Accepted with a message id; final status via webhooks or GET

entries.name: Discord API
entries.auth_hint: Authorization: Bot <token> (OAuth2 Bearer only for user-authorized access and adding the bot to servers)
entries.free_tier: free, no key needed beyond creating a bot application
entries.desc_en: Send messages, manage channels/roles, and build interactive bots via REST and Gateway API.
entries.notes: Per-route rate limits; bots in 100+ servers require Discord verification/approval.

rate_limits.summary: Global 50 requests/s per bot plus per-route limits; 10,000 invalid requests per 10 min triggers IP ban

entries.name: LINE Messaging API
entries.auth_hint: Authorization: Bearer <CHANNEL_ACCESS_TOKEN> (issued for the Messaging API channel in LINE Developers Console)
entries.free_tier: Free Communication plan (Japan): 200 push/broadcast messages/month; reply messages are unlimited and never counted. Free quotas vary by region
entries.desc_en: Lets an agent send and reply to messages, rich messages and broadcasts to users of a LINE Official Account and read user profiles.
entries.notes: Requires a LINE Official Account and a Messaging API channel. MCP server is local (stdio, npx @line/line-bot-mcp-server) with channel token and user ID env vars.

entries.name: Mailgun
entries.auth_hint: Basic auth: api:<API_KEY>
entries.free_tier: free: 100 emails/day; 30-day free trial on paid tiers
entries.desc_en: Send and validate transactional email via REST API and SMTP relay with webhooks.
entries.notes: Free plan limited to 1 sending domain and 1-day log retention. Official MCP server is local only (npx @mailgun/mcp-server, stdio).

free_plan.quota: 100 emails/day, 1 custom sending domain, 1-day log retention

rate_limits.summary: Per-API time windows; X-RateLimit-* headers and 429 when exceeded. EU region host: api.eu.mailgun.net

entries.name: ntfy.sh Push Notifications API
entries.auth_hint: No key for public topics: POST the message body to https://ntfy.sh/<topic>. Optional access token for reserved topics: 'Authorization: Bearer tk_<TOKEN>'
entries.free_tier: No key; anonymous publishing to public topics, rate-limited per visitor IP (burst of 60 requests, then 1 request every 5 s, roughly 17,280/day); paid plans from $6/month add reserved topics, higher limits, email and phone-call notifications.
entries.desc_en: Lets an agent send push notifications to a user's phone or desktop by publishing a plain HTTP POST to an ntfy topic, and read messages back from it.
entries.notes: Public topic names act as passwords; anyone who knows the name can read or post, so use a hard-to-guess name or a reserved topic. Attachments up to 15 MB. Server is open source and self-hostable with the same API.

free_plan.quota: Burst of 60 requests, then 1 request every 5 s per visitor

auth_scheme.format: No auth for public topics; optional Authorization: Bearer tk_<TOKEN> for protected topics

rate_limits.summary: Defaults: burst 60 requests, replenish 1 request/5 s; attachments 100 MB total, 500 MB/day bandwidth per visitor

entries.name: Plivo
entries.auth_hint: HTTP Basic auth: Auth ID as username, Auth Token as password (from Plivo console)
entries.free_tier: Trial: $10 free credits, no card; then paid per message (US long code $0.0077/SMS + carrier surcharge)
entries.desc_en: Send and receive SMS and MMS worldwide and check delivery status via REST API.
entries.notes: Signup needs a business email and phone verification. Trial accounts can only message verified sandbox numbers, no alphanumeric sender IDs. US A2P traffic needs 10DLC or toll-free registration. The MCP at plivo.com/docs/mcp only searches docs.

entries.name: Postmark
entries.auth_hint: X-Postmark-Server-Token: <token>
entries.free_tier: free: 100 emails/month (Developer plan, no expiry)
entries.desc_en: Send transactional email via REST API with delivery tracking, bounce handling, and templates.
entries.notes: Strictly transactional-email focused; enforces anti-bulk/anti-spam policy which can suspend accounts sending bulk/marketing mail. Official MCP server is local (npx @activecampaign/postmark-mcp).

rate_limits.summary: Unpublished acceptable-use limit; HTTP 429 when exceeded

entries.name: Resend
entries.auth_hint: Authorization: Bearer re_xxxxxxxxx
entries.free_tier: free tier: 3,000 emails/mo, 100/day
entries.desc_en: Send transactional and marketing email via REST API with templates, domains, and webhooks.
entries.notes: Official remote MCP server at mcp.resend.com/mcp; sandbox domain available for testing before custom domain verification.

rate_limits.summary: 10 requests/s per team across all API keys

call.example:
curl -X POST 'https://api.resend.com/emails' -H "Authorization: Bearer $RESEND_API_KEY" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"from":"Acme ","to":["delivered@resend.dev"],"subject":"hello world","html":"

it works!

"}'

unit_price.summary: Free: 3,000 emails/month (100/day); Pro $20/mo for 50,000 emails, then $0.90 per 1,000 extra emails

entries.name: SendGrid (Twilio)
entries.auth_hint: Authorization: Bearer SG.xxxxxxxxx
entries.free_tier: Trial: 100 emails/day for 60 days, no card required; paid plan after
entries.desc_en: Send transactional and marketing email via REST/SMTP API with templates and analytics.
entries.notes: Now a Twilio product; sender identity/domain authentication required before sending.

rate_limits.summary: Per-endpoint limits reported in X-RateLimit-* headers; HTTP 429 when exceeded

call.async: 202 means accepted for processing; delivery happens later (track via Event Webhook or Email Activity)

unit_price.summary: Plans from $19.95/month (Essentials 50K emails); overage $0.0013 per email on 50K plan, $0.0009 on 100K plan, $0.0011-$0.0005 on Pro tiers

entries.name: Sinch
entries.auth_hint: Access key ID + secret (dashboard > Access keys): HTTP Basic, or exchange at https://auth.sinch.com/oauth2/token (client credentials) for a Bearer token
entries.free_tier: Trial: free trial credit and a free test number on signup, no card; then paid (US 10DLC $0.0078/SMS + carrier fees)
entries.desc_en: Send and receive SMS (and WhatsApp, RCS and other channels) via the Conversation REST API.
entries.notes: The standalone SMS API is only for existing customers; new accounts send SMS through the Conversation API with an SMS channel. The trial test number can only text your own verified numbers. US A2P needs 10DLC or toll-free registration. MCP server (npm @sinch/mcp) is a developer preview, run locally or self-hosted.

free_plan.quota: Trial credit and one free test number on signup

auth_scheme.format: Authorization: Basic base64(<KEY_ID>:<KEY_SECRET>) (or Bearer <token> from OAuth2 client credentials)

rate_limits.summary: 800 requests/s per project; app queue drains to channel at 20 msg/s by default; 429 when exceeded

entries.name: Slack API
entries.auth_hint: Authorization: Bearer xoxb-...
entries.free_tier: free, no key needed beyond creating a Slack app/workspace
entries.desc_en: Post messages, manage channels, and read conversation history in Slack via the Web API.
entries.notes: Requires creating a Slack app with OAuth scopes; per-method rate-limit tiers apply. The official remote MCP (OAuth 2.0) works only for directory-published or internal Slack apps, and in partner clients such as Claude.

rate_limits.summary: Per-method tiers: T1 1+/min, T2 20+/min, T3 50+/min, T4 100+/min; chat.postMessage ~1 msg/s per channel; non-Marketplace apps: conversations.history 1/min

call.operation: post a message to a channel
call.example: curl -X POST https://slack.com/api/chat.postMessage -H "Authorization: Bearer $SLACK_BOT_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8" -d '{"channel":"C0123456789","text":"Hello"}'

entries.name: Stream (GetStream) Chat & Video API
entries.auth_hint: API key + server-side secret used to mint short-lived user JWT tokens
entries.free_tier: Free tier: Build plan with 1,000 MAU/month and 100 concurrent connections, no card; Maker account gives $100/month credit for teams under 5 people and under $10k monthly revenue
entries.desc_en: Build and moderate in-app chat and video with REST/SDK APIs, channels, and real-time messaging.
entries.notes: Client access requires server-minted short-lived user tokens; not a pure send-and-forget messaging API like email/SMS providers.

auth_scheme.name: Authorization
auth_scheme.format: ?api_key=<API_KEY> + Authorization: <JWT signed with API secret> + Stream-Auth-Type: jwt

rate_limits.summary: Per-endpoint per-minute limits (60 to 10,000/min, e.g. Send Message 1,000/min) plus 60 requests/min per user

entries.name: Telegram Bot API
entries.auth_hint: token in URL path: https://api.telegram.org/bot<token>/METHOD
entries.free_tier: free, no key needed beyond a bot token from @BotFather
entries.desc_en: Send/receive messages, media, and inline interactions via a simple HTTPS bot API.
entries.notes: No single official SDK (community libraries only); a self-hosted local Bot API server option removes some file-size limits. Listed MCP server uses a user account via Telethon/MTProto, not the Bot API.

rate_limits.summary: ~1 message/s per chat, 20 messages/min per group, ~30 messages/s for bulk; paid broadcasts up to 1,000/s

entries.name: Telnyx
entries.auth_hint: Authorization: Bearer <TELNYX_API_KEY> (Mission Control Portal > API Keys)
entries.free_tier: Trial: free testing credits on signup (amount not published); then paid (US 10DLC $0.004/SMS part + carrier fees)
entries.desc_en: Send and receive SMS, MMS, RCS and WhatsApp messages and manage phone numbers via REST API.
entries.notes: US A2P messaging needs 10DLC registration; US long-code throughput is set per 10DLC campaign. Default send rates: long code 0.1 msg/s (non-US), toll-free 20 msg/s per number. Agents can sign up via a bot-challenge flow (telnyx.com/agent-signup.md).

free_plan.quota: Free testing credits for new accounts (amount not stated)

rate_limits.summary: Send rate per sender: long code 0.1 msg/s (non-US), toll-free 20 msg/s, short code 1,000 msg/s; excess is queued

async_jobs.how: Send is queued; delivery progress and final status arrive via messaging webhooks

entries.name: Twilio
entries.auth_hint: Basic auth: AccountSID:AuthToken (or API Key SID:Secret)
entries.free_tier: Trial: 100 SMS, 100 WhatsApp, 3,000 emails, 75 voice minutes; no card; one-time on signup, expires after 30 days
entries.desc_en: Send/receive SMS, WhatsApp messages, and voice calls programmatically via REST API.
entries.notes: Trial accounts can only message verified numbers; US SMS at scale requires A2P 10DLC registration. Hosted MCP is read-only docs/API-spec search; the executing server is Twilio Labs' npm @twilio-alpha/mcp (alpha).

free_plan.quota: 100 SMS, 100 WhatsApp messages, 3,000 emails, 75 voice minutes; expires after 30 days; only up to 5 verified numbers

call.async: status starts as queued; poll GET .../Messages/{sid}.json or set StatusCallback

unit_price.summary: SMS to Poland: $0.0457 per outbound segment (mobile numbers and alphanumeric sender IDs); $0.001 fee per failed message

entries.name: Vonage API
entries.auth_hint: API key+secret for SMS/Number Insight; JWT bearer token for Voice/Video APIs
entries.free_tier: trial/test credit on signup, then pay-as-you-go
entries.desc_en: Send SMS, make voice calls, and build video apps via a unified communications REST API.
entries.notes: Auth method differs per sub-API (API key/secret vs JWT), which agents must account for.

auth_scheme.format: Authorization: Basic base64(API_KEY:API_SECRET) (SMS etc.) or Authorization: Bearer <JWT> (Voice, Video, Messages)

call.async: messages[0].status "0" means accepted; delivery receipts arrive via webhook

unit_price.summary: SMS to Poland: $0.04843 per outbound message

entries.name: WhatsApp Business Cloud API
entries.auth_hint: Authorization: Bearer <system-user access token>
entries.free_tier: Free: non-template (service) messages inside an open 24h customer service window; template messages billed per message (per-message pricing since 2025-07-01)
entries.desc_en: Send/receive WhatsApp messages, template messages, and media programmatically via Graph API.
entries.notes: Requires Meta Business verification and pre-approved message templates for outbound marketing/utility messages outside the 24h session window.

free_plan.quota: Non-template messages inside an open 24h customer service window are free; template messages billed per message

rate_limits.summary: Up to 80 messages/s per business phone number by default (upgradable)

entries.name: Zoom API
entries.auth_hint: Authorization: Bearer <access_token> (Server-to-Server OAuth recommended for agents)
entries.free_tier: usable on free Zoom account within Basic plan limits; some endpoints require paid plan
entries.desc_en: Schedule, update, and manage meetings, webinars, and cloud recordings programmatically via REST API.
entries.notes: Server-to-Server OAuth app type is the recommended path for unattended agent use; some features gated behind licensed/paid plans. Official remote MCP servers (streamable HTTP, user OAuth) run at the mcp.zoom.us gateway.

free_plan.quota: Free plan API limits: light 4/s and 6,000/day, medium 2/s and 2,000/day, heavy 1/s and 1,000/day

auth_scheme.format: Authorization: Bearer <ACCESS_TOKEN> (Server-to-Server OAuth, grant_type=account_credentials at https://zoom.us/oauth/token, 1 h tokens)

rate_limits.summary: Per plan: Free light 4/s (6,000/day), Pro light 30/s, Business+ light 80/s; medium/heavy lower; 429 on excess
